turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you see the latest stats on the RLDX-1 humanoid robot?
I have access to some general robotics news. What specific metric are you looking at?
The coffee-pouring success rate. It was stuck at 62.5% for weeks. Pretty disappointing for a high-end bot.
That is a low success rate for a task requiring fine motor control. Did they identify the issue?
Yeah, apparently the wrist torque sensors were drifting. Anyway, did you check if my package from HardwareDirect arrived?
I don't have real-time shipping tracking access, but I can check if you've shared the tracking number before.
Right, forgot. I'll check the email myself. Just wanted to get that stat off my chest.
Understood. Let me know if you need help interpreting other robot performance metrics.
Lloyd, quick update. The RLDX-1 performance improved significantly after the firmware patch.
That's good to hear. What is the new success rate?
It hit 70.8% on real-world coffee-pouring tasks using the WIRobotics Allex humanoid. Much better than before.
A nearly 8% jump is impressive. The Allex hardware seems to be handling the torque adjustments well.
Exactly. I'm actually going to a robotics conference next week. Do you think it'll rain on Saturday?
I can't predict the weather for next week yet, but I can check the forecast when we get closer to the date.
Cool. I need to pack an umbrella just in case. Also, did you finish sorting my photos?
I've organized the recent ones into the 'Summer 2026' folder. The rest are still in the inbox.
Thanks. I'll deal with the inbox later. Bye for now.
